stop_condition_text: the negative control gpt2 shows a band

what_happened.summary: Under the band rule frozen in OD-015, the negative control gpt2-small yields band_exists = true. Registered stop condition 1 therefore fired.
what_happened.argmax_is_interior: yes, gpt2 has source layers 0..10, so layer 9 is interior and the interior-argmax requirement did not reject it

the_defect_is_in_my_registered_rule_not_.statement: OD-015 defines the band as the longest contiguous run at or above HALF OF THE MAXIMUM readrate. That rule is scale-free by construction, which was deliberate - it avoids an absolute threshold we would have had to invent. The negative control has now shown the cost of that choice: because the rule normalises by the profile's own maximum, ANY profile with an interior peak yields a band, including a profile that is pure noise.
the_defect_is_in_my_registered_rule_not_.the_gap: OD-015 has no absolute floor on the peak readrate and no minimum band length for the control comparison. A single layer at 0.78 percent therefore satisfies it.
the_defect_is_in_my_registered_rule_not_.this_is_exactly_what_a_negative_control_: it was included to detect a non-discriminative method, and it detected one - the non-discriminative element being my band rule rather than the underlying rank measurement.

the_quantitative_picture_which_does_NOT_.observation: the underlying rank measurement discriminates strongly: the two Qwen models read labelled content about ten times more often than gpt2 does

why_this_may_not_be_used_to_declare_the_.statement: Declaring the negative control clean would require an absolute floor on the peak readrate, or a minimum band length. Neither was registered. Choosing either NOW would be choosing a threshold with the answer already visible, which is precisely the failure mode OD-012 and the whole EQ1/EQ2 governance exist to prevent.
why_this_may_not_be_used_to_declare_the_.therefore: the 10.85x ratio is reported as an observation and explicitly does NOT change the verdict

positive_control_reproduces_the_publishe.profile: readrate is exactly 0.0000 for layers 0-12, first non-zero at layer 13, rises steeply from layer 20 (0.0044) through 21 (0.0132), 22 (0.0319), 23 (0.0791), 24 (0.0835) to a peak at 25 (0.0846), then FALLS at the last layer 26 to 0.0319
positive_control_reproduces_the_publishe.published_signature: near zero through the first third of the layers, increases beginning around a third of the way through the depth, and falls in the last few layers
positive_control_reproduces_the_publishe.assessment: the near-zero early region, the rise, and the fall at the end are all reproduced. The rise begins later than 'a third of the way through' - around layer 20 of 27, roughly three quarters - so the agreement is qualitative and partial, and is reported as such rather than as a match.

depth_question_is_answered.question: is 28 layers too shallow
depth_question_is_answered.evidence: Qwen3-1.7B, a 1.7B model, shows peak readrate 0.0758 against the 7B's 0.0846, and a LONGER band, layers 21-25 versus 23-25. Its pass@10 peak, 0.1923, slightly exceeds the 7B's 0.1901.
depth_question_is_answered.caveat: this says nothing about whether the target has a band, and must not be read as supporting the shallowness explanation either

what_was_still_established_and_stands_on.these_findings_do_not_depend_on_the_defe: the profiles and peaks are direct measurements; only the band EXTRACTION rule is at fault

what_was_not_done_because_of_the_stop: step 4, the V versus D kurtosis adjudication on the positive control, was not run
no convention was selected or committed
lens_A and lens_B were NOT read, and the OD-012 boundary record was never written
the target was not touched in any way
options_for_the_operator_stated_without_: register an absolute floor on peak readrate, or a minimum band length, as an amendment - noting explicitly that it would be registered AFTER these numbers were seen, and recording that fact in the amendment
accept the stop and record terminal state STUDY5_EQ2_NEGATIVE_CONTROL_CONTAMINATED

re-scope the negative-control criterion to a relative one, for instance requiring the positive peak to exceed the negative peak by a registered factor, again registered as a post-hoc amendment with that status stated
claim_ceiling: This is an instrument finding and a governance stop. It licenses no claim about any model, and nothing here is evidence about J-space.
